title: Nine Minutes of Making
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：coffee　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 coffee 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my mother was sent to make ① coffee she could not drink, and she said the making was the whole of the lesson. The ② coffee, meaning the cup and not the bean, was nine minutes late and was made by whoever came last; coffee, she said, is the only thing in a kitchen that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ coffee in that kitchen had the same smell, and the ④ coffee at the end, meaning the one the host kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever made properly. Coffee, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ coffee was the whole of the morning, meaning the talk it carried and not the cup. The ⑥ coffee, meaning the talk and not any of that, is the only thing in a morning that everybody stays for and nobody questions; coffee, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a cup and a talk. She said the talk is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ coffee had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the smell. The ⑧ coffee of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine minutes and eleven years of making; coffee, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ coffee I remember is the one at the end, which was made in 1973 and is still described as the strongest in the county. A ⑩ coffee, my grandmother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being made; every coffee, she said, is a talk that has agreed to look like a cup. She said the talk was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 咖啡（指那一杯咖啡本身，与那些豆子相对）
C. 固定搭配：make coffee 煮咖啡
D. n. 咖啡（指那间厨房里每一杯）
E. n. 咖啡（指末尾那一杯）
F. n. 闲谈（抽象：它带来的那场谈话）
G. n. 那场谈话（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The coffee, meaning the cup and not the bean
coffee was the whole of the morning
the coffee had become a number in a report
The coffee of the whole thing
A coffee, my grandmother said in 1978

answers.why: make coffee 意为“煮咖啡”，1953 年母亲被派去煮她喝不下的那壶咖啡。
coffee 意为“咖啡”，指那一杯咖啡本身而不是那些豆子，晚九分钟，由最后来的人煮。
coffee 指那间厨房里每一杯咖啡，每一杯都是同样的香气。
coffee 指末尾那一杯（主人留下的那一杯），是唯一有人认真煮过的。
coffee 意为“闲谈”，抽象指它带来的那场谈话，父亲说 coffee 就是那个早晨的全部。
coffee 为抽象用法，指那场谈话本身，是一个早晨里人人都留下、却没人质疑的东西。
coffee 意为“咖啡”，到 1968 年这壶 coffee 成了报告里的一个数字。
coffee 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九分钟和十一年的烹煮。
coffee 意为“咖啡”，我记得的是末尾那一杯，1973 年煮过，至今仍被说成全县最浓的。
coffee 为抽象总称，祖母说一杯咖啡是唯一会因为被认真烹煮而变好的东西。
